name: MVTec AD 2: Advanced Scenarios for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
description: Next-generation industrial visual anomaly detection benchmark comprising 8,004 high-resolution images across eight challenging scenarios (Can, Fabric, Fruit Jelly, Rice, Sheet Metal, Vial, Wall Plugs, and Walnuts). Features advanced inspection challenges including transparent and overlapping objects, dark-field and backlight illumination, high normal data variance, subtle border anomalies, and systematic distribution shifts through controlled lighting variations evaluated via a centralized benchmark server.

provenance.collection_method: High-resolution camera setups capturing 8 industrial scenarios under multiple controlled illumination settings (regular, overexposed, underexposed, dark-field, and backlight).
provenance.curation_notes: Test data is split into public test (1,084 images with public ground truth masks), private test (2,045 images with nominal illumination), and private mixed test (2,045 images with mixed illumination shifts).
